key_findings: Spinal LIFU for 4 weeks alleviated PNI-induced mechanical allodynia and increased dorsal horn KCC2 expression in rats.
LIFU decreased CaMKIV and p-CREB but did not change p-ERK1/2, suggesting action via the CaMKIV-KCC2 pathway.
